notes: Later filings revised 2 of these figures (for example, twelve months to Dec 31, 2023: $83,400,000 first reported, $82,900,000 in the 20-F filed 2026-04-30). This data keeps the first reported figures.
Older filings report this line in RUB with a USD translation; they are not used. Figures for 2022 and 2023 come from later filings that report in USD.
This series has full-year figures only (from annual reports), so there are no quarters.
This line also includes purchases of intangible assets.
